cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James reported that its Private Client Group had record quarterly net revenue of $3.06 billion, up 15% year-over-year, in its fiscal fourth quarter.
items.quote: The Private Client Group had record quarterly net revenue of $3.06 billion, up 15% year-over-year and pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year.

items.text: Raymond James reported Private Client Group pre-tax income of $458 million for the quarter, up 10% year-over-year.
items.quote: The Private Client Group had record quarterly net revenue of $3.06 billion, up 15% year-over-year and pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year.

items.text: Raymond James reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year.
items.quote: Overall, the firm reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year.

items.text: Raymond James reported domestic Private Client Group net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion, with quarterly net new assets of nearly $23 billion.
items.quote: Domestic PCG net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion. Net new assets for the quarter were nearly $23 billion, with annualized growth from the beginning of the quarter of 5.3%.

items.text: Commentary noted that Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, having last officially broken out about 8,900 advisors.
items.quote: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, but it had about 8,900 advisors the last time headcount was officially broken out.

items.text: Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, a 2% increase year-over-year, and said it expects continued momentum with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments.
items.quote: As Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year, the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year.

items.text: In its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings commentary, Raymond James said it recruited $538 million in trailing 12-month production for advisors entering its domestic independent contractor and employee channels, up from $407 million, and that those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James reported its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings last week and said it recruited $538 million in trailing 12-month production for advisors entering its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million in the prior year. Those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee advisor channels

items.text: Raymond James announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, risk-based model portfolios blending traditional and alternative investments, with Private Client Group President Tash Elwyn calling it a meaningful addition to private wealth resources.
items.quote: "At Raymond James, we're committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve... Private Wealth Guided Portfolios are a meaningful addition to those resources, providing advisors with another way to help clients access alternative investments thoughtfully and in alignment with their goals."
items.scope: Private Client Group / private wealth platform

items.text: Raymond James said nearly 450 advisors had earned its Private Wealth Advisor designation as of September 2026, and that its Asset Management Services group oversees portfolio construction for the new models with its private markets and alternatives team.
items.quote: Since launching in 2022, nearly 450 advisors have earned the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation, according to the firm. ... Raymond James asset management services group oversees portfolio construction for the models and works with the firm's private markets and alternatives team

items.text: Raymond James made a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program available to its roughly 8,900 advisors, according to a regulatory filing and a spokesperson.
items.quote: Raymond James has made its small-business retirement plan available to its roughly 8,900 advisors, according to a regulatory filing and a spokesperson.

items.text: Raymond James' acquisition of Clark Capital Management Group, an asset manager with more than $46 billion under management, closed in May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management's multi-boutique structure.
items.quote: the firm agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group, a Philadelphia-based asset manager with more than $46 billion under management... That transaction closed in May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management's multi-boutique structure.

items.text: On M&A commentary, executive Shoukry said the firm looks for acquisitions in the wealth management business in particular, but only where there is a good cultural and strategic fit, and that it does not do acquisitions to slash costs.
items.quote: "We don't do acquisitions to slash costs," he said. "We do acquisitions to grow revenues and to be better firms together over time..."

items.text: Raymond James' employee advisor channel, Raymond James & Associates, added a Washington, D.C. three-advisor team from PNC Private Bank that managed over $1.5 billion in client assets, operating as KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown.
items.quote: Raymond James has recruited a Washington, D.C.-based three-advisor team that previously managed over $1.5 billion in client assets at PNC Private Bank. The team will operate as KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown, a unit of Raymond James & Associates.

items.text: Raymond James' independent channel, Raymond James Financial Services, added a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network operating as Harris Wealth Partners in Rochester, New York, with approximately $500 million in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial Services (RJFS) welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel, adding approximately $500 million in client assets to its roster.
items.scope: Raymond James Financial Services (independent advisor channel)
